blind_spots: Reflection and config-driven instantiation are invisible to constant-pool analysis.

Churn is computed on a semantic fingerprint (debug info, constant-pool order, and stack frames stripped); residual cross-compiler noise (e.g. different bridge-method or lambda-name generation) can still over-report — never under-report.
A behavior change with zero structural fingerprint will not be detected — this is why the canary and rollback stay in the plan for every grade, including A.
